data.title: bn-vqx: Rearrange Operation Lilybreaker across six channels
data.description: Review the revised six-voice ABC mix after user feedback that the first mix was dissonant and underused the six-channel space. Verify voice/timbre separation, meter and duration, harmonic cleanup, rough-interval comparison, Console playback, documentation accuracy, and gameplay tradeoff disclosure. Full just check and 20-second host playback passed.

data.body: MEDIUM: The stated rough-pair numerators do not reproduce from the score under the documented definition. An independent 1/16-grid parse using ABC D-minor key-signature and bar-accidental semantics reproduces the denominators exactly (3,360 and 3,293 overlap pairs), but counts minor-second/tritone pitch-class pairs as 234 and 14, not 370 and 62. Please either document the additional intervals/weighting used by the calculation or correct the figures so this evidence is reproducible.

LOW: The extraction description still says 'all four lanes return,' but this revision is expressly a six-role arrangement. Rename this to the actual returning roles or 'all six lanes' so the form description matches the score.

data.reason: Approved: the six-voice score is structurally valid, maps to all six intended preview waveforms, creates real rhythmic/register space, renders 64.00s/960 starts with zero warnings or steals, and accurately discloses the SFX-channel tradeoff. Two non-blocking documentation corrections are threaded.
Corrected the rough-pair figures to the reviewer's independently reproduced 234/3360 (7.0%) and 14/3293 (0.4%).
Changed the extraction description from four lanes to all six roles.
